svg.title: Randomisation is the whole argument
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “Randomisation is the whole argument” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A whiteboard sketch showing a stream of users passing through a coin-flip splitter into arms A and B, with arm B crossed out in red because a sample ratio mismatch of 50,000 against 48,000 gives chi-squared 40.82 and p equal to 1.7 times ten to the minus ten; a bar chart of required sample size rising from 8,158 per arm for a twenty percent lift to 122,124 for a five percent lift; a wandering p-value line crossing the 0.05 threshold several times with the first crossing ringed in red and false-positive rates of 5.1, 8.2, 13.6, 18.8 and 25.1 percent for one, two, five, ten and twenty looks; two scatter clouds showing CUPED tightening the variance by 81 percent; and a blank pre-registration card.
svg.text: draw it from memory, then compare
